title: Iceberg connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Iceberg connector instance's settings: the catalog it reads or writes through, the warehouse, the namespace and table, and the snapshot cursor the incremental scan resumes from. Covers both directions of the ★ Iceberg connector (design §33 §8 row 7; CN1 plan Task 9, Lakekeeper as the catalog in CI). `s3.access_key_id` and `s3.secret_access_key` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

catalog_url.description: The REST catalog endpoint, Lakekeeper's in CN1.

warehouse.description: The warehouse location the catalog serves.

namespace.description: The Iceberg namespace, as its parts in one string, for example `analytics.events`.

table.description: The table this instance scans or writes; may be omitted when a route names it.

snapshot_cursor.description: The last snapshot id the source committed; an incremental scan reads the snapshots after it and an absent value means a full scan (CN1 Task 9).

scan_mode.description: How the source treats snapshots it did not create: incremental reads only append snapshots, and an overwrite snapshot is rescanned whole and flagged (CN1 Task 9's iceberg_overwrite_rescans_and_flags).

flag_overwrite_snapshots.description: Emit the loamsoverwrite extension on an event read out of a rescanned overwrite snapshot.

partitions.description: Parallel readers the scan is split across.

commit_mode.description: How the sink commits: an Iceberg append, or Fluss tiering for a Fabric table, which runs nothing (CN1 Task 9).

partition_by.description: The declared key the bulk path partitions by (D356).

s3.description: Object-store access for the warehouse's data and metadata files.

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, for RustFS or MinIO in development and CI.

access_key_id.description: The static access key id. Resolved through the secret store (D189); absent when a role chain is used.

secret_access_key.description: The static secret access key. Resolved through the secret store (D189); absent when a role chain is used.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 (or workload-identity federation) settings for a cloud warehouse; the manifest's auth slugs iam, sa and oauth2.

token_url.description: The token endpoint credentials are fetched from.

audience.description: The audience requested, where the provider needs one.
